scientific_integrity: All cardinality-six configurations and their exchanges were enumerated exhaustively; the no-smaller-forcing-set assertion was checked for all cardinalities zero through five, and all 1704 jumping-state BFS eccentricities were computed. No finite samples were extrapolated to an infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite classification specific to the 16-vertex Möbius–Kantor graph; no assertion for all generalized Petersen graphs. Literature priority is not independently certified; unindexed equivalent results remain possible. Two executed standard-library finite enumerators corroborate the claim, without external independent audit.
title: A sharp token-jumping versus token-sliding dichotomy for minimum zero forcing in the Möbius–Kantor graph
